name: Norsk nynorsk bibel 1921
statement: Published in 1921 and out of copyright in Norway under the 70-year term following the death of the translators. Public domain.

evidence.quote: Elles var fleire med på å omsetja større eller mindre delar av skriftene. Mellom desse kan nemnast Lars Eskeland, Jon Mannsåker, Arne Bergsgård, [...] Erik Eggen [...] Det Norske Bibelselskapet sikra seg rettane til bibelutgåva

verification.note: CrossWire marks it public domain, but the statement this file carried (70 years after the death of the translators) does not hold. Studentmållagsbibelen had some twenty named translators, each translating separate books, and the Bible Society bought the rights. Under the Norwegian Copyright Act (åndsverkloven § 11) each part is protected until 70 years after its translator's death: Jon Mannsåker died in 1964 (protected to the end of 2034), Erik Eggen in 1957 (to the end of 2027). Not published until the rights holder (Bibelselskapet) confirms, or the last term runs out.
